candidates.raw_title: LEQEMBI (lecanemab) Subcutaneous Formulation as an Initiation Treatment for Early Alzheimer's Disease Approved in China
candidates.gate_e: Directly on-question -- geographic-expansion regulatory approval of the already-tracked LEQEMBI IQLIK high-concentration (200 mg/mL vs. 100 mg/mL IV) SC platform, extending its commercial validation to a second major market (China NMPA) on the same dosing regimen as the US launch.

findings.event: China NMPA approval of the SC/initiation formulation as an Alzheimer's treatment
findings.summary: China's NMPA approved LEQEMBI's SC/initiation formulation (500 mg weekly, two 250 mg injections) for early Alzheimer's disease, extending the already-tracked 200 mg/mL SC (vs. 100 mg/mL IV) technology's commercial validation from the US to China on the same regimen.
